column1: # not-for-cache.tsv -- store paths that must never be in the runtime closure of anything offered to cache.solnix.io
# (check B12, scripts/gate-checks.py closure). One rule per line: kind <TAB> regex <TAB> why.
#   name    regex on the store path's name (after <hash>-); a CA-lane path (scripts/ca-lane.tsv) is allowed even if named
#   path    regex on the full store path; never excused by the CA lane
#   unfree  regex on the name; allowed only when the row's flags say unfree=y (pre-submit passes GATE_ALLOW_UNFREE=1)
# Keep this the one list; publish-gate.sh, pre-submit-check.sh and the infra mirror read it.

column3: a NixOS-style system toplevel: one host's configuration (hostname, users, keys)
a system profile (environment.systemPackages of one host)
a home-manager generation: one user's files
a nix-env profile: one user's package set
the illumos-gate proto: served ONLY through the CA lane (fixed-output), never as a built path
nixpkgs-unfree: not redistributable by this cache
a slice copied from the build host's / (pkgs/illumos/toolchains.nix srcRoot = "/"): host-specific bits
Intel wireless firmware: redistributable only under its licence; only a row that says unfree=y
NVIDIA GSP firmware / driver .run: unfree; only a row that says unfree=y
